question: Which current implementation minimizes the risk and scope of reaching a trustworthy consolidation branch while preserving the best available ideas from all three agents?

candidates.headline: Preserve the only representative, demonstrated end-to-end surge workflow.
candidates.rationale: GPT has the strongest functional evidence and the smallest fixed-reviewer finding set. Its systemic defects are serious, but they primarily harden durable handoffs, partial failures, and lifecycle races around an already joined-up execution chain.

candidates.headline: Use the strongest architectural donor without inheriting its lifecycle protocol.
candidates.rationale: Opus leads the unweighted reference comparison and contains excellent decomposition, Redis, metrics, packaging, and testing ideas. Its completion delivery and terminal-summary workflow require structural stabilization before it can be trusted as a base.

candidates.headline: Port bounded strengths after separating the local load-envelope bug from systemic debt.
candidates.rationale: GLM's visible under-delivery is partly a fixable k6 capacity problem, but its residual activation, completion, admission, finalization, worker, and ERP defects create the broadest cross-service repair surface.

limitations: This assessment was read-only: no runtime or test suite was started.
Browser-use sessions covered different flows and scales, so finding totals are not direct quality scores.

The Opus browser report records successful tiny custom runs while later representative testing reports unfinished runs; the recommendation treats completion as timing- and load-sensitive rather than universally impossible.
The user's later representative runtime observations are included as decision evidence but are not yet captured by a standardized cross-branch test protocol.

consolidationPhases.title: Freeze demonstrated behavior
consolidationPhases.summary: Capture representative surge, sold-out, idempotency, lifecycle, history, and recovery behavior before changing architecture.

consolidationPhases.title: Harden the correctness spine
consolidationPhases.summary: Implement lifecycle fencing, durable completion and order dispatch, autonomous pending-hold recovery, ERP idempotency, Redis-first eligibility, and secret hardening as one coordinated milestone.

consolidationPhases.title: Port donor invariants
consolidationPhases.summary: Bring selected Opus and GLM behaviors and regression tests through GPT's boundaries instead of merging whole service trees.

consolidationPhases.title: Consolidate secondary surfaces
consolidationPhases.summary: After the execution spine is trustworthy, merge the best DTO, dashboard, admin, database, test, operational, and documentation choices.
